One person. Founded September 2024. Bootstrapped. The profile says it is used in 30-plus countries. France.

mentions.indieAngle: Signage money is usually a price per screen for a business with more than one location. This listing is the small end of that.

whyItPrints: Menu boards and lobby screens. A self-host option is how it gets around. The listing is for sale.
whyThisMatters:
Obscreen puts pictures and video on a screen: a TV, a computer, a tablet, or a browser. Cloud, or on the customer's own machine. Restaurants, shops, warehouses, gyms, hospitals, offices. One person, in France, started in September 2024, no outside money. The profile says thirty-plus countries.

Stripe shows a few dozen subscriptions and a monthly line under five hundred. The last thirty days are in the same small range. The all-time total is the whole life of a young listing, and it is much larger than one month, so the early months were not zero. Margin is claimed at eighty percent. The asking price is twenty-five thousand. Nobody's offer count is in the brief, so I am not writing one.

You pay so the menu or the lobby notice is a screen, not a piece of paper. The money in signage is usually per screen, at a chain. This is the small end.
